messages:
Rina: Heads-up: we're targeting publish Fri 09:00 UTC for the Optimize benchmarks blog. Embargo in place until then. Draft is at https://go.redwood/opt-bench-v2 (final pass in comments).
Omar: Copy. I'll queue the embargo emails to the press list at 08:40 UTC and do a second wave at 08:55 UTC for EU outlets.
Ethan: I'll own live-monitoring for traffic and social. Ops, can you confirm rate-limit windows and any runbook pointers in case of traffic surge?
Ops: Confirmed. Autoscaling policy has a 3-min warmup; we've bumped burst cap to +25% for the window 08:50-10:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/publish-surge
Rina: Add partner callout for PartnerCo and the partner quote (legal cleared). Please ensure partner handled in the metadata so syndication shows proper attribution.
Legal: Confirmed partner quote approved. Quick note: don't publish partner internal benchmarks table; use the summary line only.
Omar: Press list ready: TechCrunch, The Verge, FT, Bloomberg EU, Wired. Sending out embargo notices now.
press-bot: Scheduled: embargo_email_sender will fire at 08:40 UTC (in ~40m).
Ethan: Social copy drafted; will wait for final hero image from design. Also prepping two rapid-response FAQ bullets for likely questions about quantization tradeoffs.
Rina: FAQ bullet for methodology: 'All runs on Dedicated-8xA100, sequence=2048, median of five runs; caching disabled to measure pure runtime.' Keep that sentence in the post.
Omar: One more ask: if a reporter needs an on-the-record engineer, Ethan is the primary and Ops is the backup.
Ethan: Got it. I'll be on standby 08:50-10:30 UTC.
Rina: Publish checklist (react when done): 1) press emails queued 2) hero image in place 3) CDN purge timing set 4) social scheduled 5) runbook bookmarked
Omar: :thumbsup: all queued
Ethan: :thumbsup: hero image uploaded
Ops: CDN purge set to T+00:05; logs retention increased for 2h.
Rina: Quick publish command (manual):
```
# publish one-off
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/publish -H "Authorization: Bearer $PUBLISH_TOKEN" -d '{"slug":"optimize-bench-v2"}'
```
Rina: If anything blocks, post in #release-control. See you on the final sync at 08:55 UTC.
